platforms.label: Google Business Profile
platforms.description: Turn Google messages and booking requests into leads in your Lead Inbox.
instructions: Google emails the profile owner for every new message or booking request
Forward those notification emails to the inbound address below
Gmail: Settings › Filters › from:google.com "Business Profile" › Forward
Each forwarded message becomes a lead with the sender's name and note

platforms.label: Instagram / Facebook
platforms.description: Bring DMs and lead-form submissions from Meta into your CRM.
instructions: Meta emails you when someone messages your page or fills in a lead form
Forward those notification emails to the inbound address below
Or connect a Zapier / Make zap from Meta Lead Ads to the webhook URL below

platforms.label: Yelp
platforms.description: Forward Yelp messages and requests into your Lead Inbox.
instructions: Yelp for Business → Account Settings → Notifications
Turn on email alerts for "Request a quote" / messages
Forward those alerts to the inbound address below

platforms.label: Website contact form
platforms.description: Every form submission on your website becomes a lead.
instructions: Point your website form's notification email at the inbound address below
Or use the webhook URL below with Zapier / Make from any form builder
